scope: Two separate readings of original financial tables; all displayed event-attributable dollar facts in the selected table. Original code and outputs were unopened during source review.

FN05.scope: 21st Century Holding Company's reported 2005 hurricane losses and LAE. The group identifies Federated National's homeowners exposure elsewhere. The table and its preceding discussion use consolidated company wording and do not allocate each cell exclusively to the subsidiary.
FN05.controls: Claim count 2,076 has no dollar unit. Gross loss less recoveries equals net loss. Another hurricane, Wilma, also has $3.0m net; only the Katrina row scores. $155.5m/$146.6m/$8.9m aggregate the 2005 events. In the later repeated table the figures are rounded differently.

MD12.scope: Reporting group and its three named component businesses, for the year ended December 31, 2012. The paragraph directly before this table names Sandy, and the heading and rows identify incurred losses, owners and units.
MD12.controls: The $25m–$35m range is the earlier estimate of net underwriting impact after excess reinsurance and the normalized catastrophe provision. It does not replace the final incurred-loss amounts. The industry estimate exceeds $20bn. The second numeric row contains percentages. The group total includes all three components.

SF12.scope: The text explicitly attributes the entire fourth-quarter catastrophe loss of $7,977 thousand to Superstorm Sandy and the same FY2012 hurricane/tropical-storm cell has exactly that value. The local MD&A and report express monetary amounts in thousands. No additional storm shares that annual dollar total in the reporting precision.
SF12.controls: The FY2011 hurricane/tropical storm cell ($7.025m) belongs to a year before Sandy. The $10.332m FY2012 catastrophe total includes $2.355m of windstorm/hail losses. The definition of qualifying catastrophes uses a pre-tax, pre-reinsurance threshold, which alone does not label every table measure. The footnote defines which loss-adjustment costs the table includes.
